name: How to Set Up Email Integration
description: Step-by-step guide to connect Gmail or Outlook with your CRM for automatic email tracking and two-way sync

step.name: Connect Your Email Account
step.text: Navigate to Settings > Integrations > Email. Click 'Connect Gmail' or 'Connect Outlook'. Authorize access to your email account by signing in and granting permissions.

step.name: Configure Sync Settings
step.text: Choose which folders to sync (Inbox, Sent, specific labels). Select sync frequency (real-time, every 15 minutes, or hourly). Enable automatic contact creation for new email addresses.

step.name: Test the Integration
step.text: Send a test email to a contact in your CRM. Verify the email appears in the contact's activity timeline within the configured sync time. Check that replies are tracked automatically.

step.name: Enable Email Templates
step.text: Go to Settings > Email Templates. Create templates for common emails (follow-up, introduction, meeting request). Use merge fields to personalize with contact data.
